verses.text_uthmani: حمٓ
verses.translation: Ha Mim

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
verses.translation: By the Scripture that makes things clear,

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَـٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
verses.translation: truly We sent it down on a blessed night––We have always sent warnings––

verses.text_uthmani: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
verses.translation: a night when every matter of wisdom was made distinct

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْرًا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
verses.translation: at Our command––We have always sent messages to man––

verses.text_uthmani: رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.translation: as a mercy [Prophet] from your Lord who sees and knows all,

verses.text_uthmani: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
verses.translation: Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything between––if only you people were firm believers––

verses.text_uthmani: لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.translation: there is no god but Him: He gives life and death––He is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers––

verses.text_uthmani: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ
verses.translation: yet in [their state of] doubt they take nothing seriously.

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.translation: [Prophet], watch out for the Day when the sky brings forth clouds of smoke for all to see.

verses.text_uthmani: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَـٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.translation: It will envelop the people. They will cry, ‘This is a terrible torment!

verses.text_uthmani: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.translation: Lord relieve us from this torment! We believe!’

verses.text_uthmani: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.translation: How will this [sudden] faith benefit them? When a prophet came to warn them plainly,

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ
verses.translation: they turned their backs on him, saying, ‘He is tutored! He is possessed!’

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ
verses.translation: We shall hold the torment back for a while ––you are sure to return [to Us]––

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
verses.translation: and on the Day We seize [them] mightily We shall exact retribution.

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ
verses.translation: We tested the people of Pharaoh before them: a noble messenger was sent to them,

verses.text_uthmani: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
verses.translation: saying, ‘Hand the servants of God over to me! I am a faithful messenger who has been sent to you.

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.translation: Do not consider yourselves to be above God! I come to you with clear authority.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ
verses.translation: I seek refuge in my Lord and yours against your insults!

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ
verses.translation: If you do not believe me, just let me be.’

verses.text_uthmani: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ
verses.translation: [Moses] cried to his Lord, ‘These people are evildoers!’

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
verses.translation: [God replied], ‘Escape in the night with My servants, for you are sure to be pursued.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ
verses.translation: Leave the sea behind you parted and their army will be drowned.’

verses.text_uthmani: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.translation: Many a garden and spring they left behind,

verses.text_uthmani: وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
verses.translation: many a cornfield and noble building,

verses.text_uthmani: وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهِينَ
verses.translation: many a thing in which they had delighted:

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
verses.translation: We gave these to another people to inherit.

verses.text_uthmani: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ
verses.translation: Neither heavens nor earth shed a tear for them, nor were they given any time.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verses.translation: We saved the Children of Israel from their degrading suffering

verses.text_uthmani: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verses.translation: at the hands of Pharaoh: he was a tyrant who exceeded all bounds.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.translation: We chose them knowingly above others:

verses.text_uthmani: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَـٰٓؤٌا۟ مُّبِينٌ
verses.translation: We gave them revelations in which there was a clear test.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
verses.translation: These people here assert,

verses.text_uthmani: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
verses.translation: ‘There is nothing beyond our one death: we will not be resurrected.

verses.text_uthmani: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.translation: Bring back our forefathers, if what you say is true.’

verses.text_uthmani: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
verses.translation: Are they better than the people of Tubba and those who flourished before them? We destroyed them all- they were guilty.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ
verses.translation: We were not playing a pointless game when We created the heavens and earth and everything in between;

verses.text_uthmani: مَا خَلَقْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.translation: We created them for a true purpose, but most people do not comprehend.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَـٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.translation: The Day of Decision is the time appointed for all;

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًى شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.translation: a Day when no friend can take another’s place.

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.translation: No one will receive any help except for those to whom God shows mercy: He is the Mighty, the Merciful Lord.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
verses.translation: The tree of Zaqqum

verses.text_uthmani: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ
verses.translation: will be food for the sinners:

verses.text_uthmani: كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ
verses.translation: [hot] as molten metal, it boils in their bellies

verses.text_uthmani: كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
verses.translation: like seething water.

verses.text_uthmani: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.translation: ‘Take him! Thrust him into the depths of Hell!

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
verses.translation: Pour scalding water over his head as punishment!’

verses.text_uthmani: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
verses.translation: ‘Taste this, you powerful, respected man!

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ
verses.translation: This is what you doubted.’

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ
verses.translation: But those mindful of God will be in a safe place

verses.text_uthmani: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.translation: amid Gardens and springs,

verses.text_uthmani: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
verses.translation: clothed in silk and fine brocade, facing one another:

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
verses.translation: so it will be. We shall wed them to maidens with large, dark eyes.

verses.text_uthmani: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَـٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
verses.translation: Secure and contented, they will call for every kind of fruit.

verses.text_uthmani: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.translation: After the one death they will taste death no more. God will guard them from the torment of Hell,

verses.text_uthmani: فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
verses.translation: a bounty from your Lord. That is the supreme triumph.

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَـٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.translation: We have made this Quran easy to understand- in your own language [Prophet]- so that they may take heed.

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ
verses.translation: So wait; the disbelievers too are waiting.
